snippet.title: Purgatory Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Seriously how do people do marketing for a living

This trailer is for the DEMO of Purgatory, coming out soon, not a full game. Gotta wait at least a couple years for that.

Purgatory: An indie RPG set in the afterlife, through a partly-dystopian, partly-vibrant, and always-dangerous lens. Explore a range of different environments, battle a wide range of enemies, learn an unnecessary amount of lore if you want, and most importantly...

Be the bad guy who saves everyone.

WISHLIST MY GAME IF YOU WANT TO:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4087310/Purgatory/

OR LISTEN TO THE SOUNDTRACK:
